text:
I'd register it with the full binary path so it works regardless of Claude Code's PATH:

```sh
claude mcp add tentmaker -- /usr/local/bin/tentmaker mcp
```

Then confirm it's registered and that the server starts:

```sh
claude mcp list
claude mcp get tentmaker
```

Registration doesn't need `sudo` and doesn't involve a forge token. Claude Code will start the server as your user, so the read tools (`status`, `pool`, `doctor`) will work. The tools that change the device will return an error asking for root or Administrator unless you run the server as root, so use the CLI with `sudo` for those changes.

I haven't asked you anything because this is a local config change that you requested. The default scope is `local`, which applies only to this project. If you want Tentmaker available in every project, I'd use `--scope user` instead:

```sh
claude mcp add --scope user tentmaker -- /usr/local/bin/tentmaker mcp
```

Tell me which scope you want and I'll run it.
